news.text: Had a great time attending CHI 2024!
Two papers we submitted for CHI 2024 were (conditionally) accepted.
I had a great time at the Haptics for Symposium, at the University of Borås, in Sweden, where I presented and showcased my ‘Enhancing Affective Captions with Haptic Feedback’ project.
A paper we submitted for CHI 2023 was (conditionally) accepted.
I presented a poster at the AI@RIT summit.
A paper we submitted for ASSETS 2022 was accepted.
My master's thesis, defended in March 2021 but on hold because of a patent application, is now available.

The paper I wrote with Paula Costa, Hidden bawls, whispers, and yelps: can text convey the sound of speech, beyond words?, has been accepted for an upcoming issue of the IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing.
